title: Transparent GUI Pack
description: Fully transparent Minecraft GUIs for a clean and distraction-free experience.
body:
A clean and minimal Minecraft resource pack that makes all major GUIs fully transparent while keeping text, slots, and functionality perfectly visible. Designed for a distraction-free experience, better visibility, and a sleek modern look.

Works on inventory, anvil, smithing table, crafting table, and more.

Made by HexaDev
